objective: Separate durable identity, current operational projection and temporal history while preserving certified GARPI runtime semantics and never fabricating legacy provenance.
global_invariants: workers remains the current operational workforce projection until explicit certified cutover
workers.id is not durable historical person identity
person_id is the target stable internal person identifier
normalized valid Chilean RUT is the canonical business key when available
person identity is never inferred from person_name alone
historical relationships are never fabricated when evidence is insufficient
reservation and movement are independent business processes
Capacity V1 semantics remain unchanged during P2 foundations
operational_revision remains authoritative until explicit certified replacement
closed snapshot provenance is never rewritten or fabricated
P2 foundations are additive before explicit cutover
destructive legacy history rewrites are forbidden

person.business_key_rule: unique when a valid canonical RUT is available
person.durability: must survive replacement of workers operational projection

company.business_key: canonical company code/name under explicit governance
company.normalization: canonical record plus explicit alias mapping
company.merge_rule: never silently merge companies using fuzzy similarity

shift.merge_rule: never silently infer equivalent shifts from similar text

camp.legacy_rule: missing camp identity remains unresolved unless deterministic evidence exists

bed.legacy_rule: existing physical composite key remains supported until certified cutover

invariants: one person cannot have overlapping ACTIVA assignments in the same operational universe
one bed cannot have overlapping ACTIVA assignments in the same operational universe
assignment history never depends on workers.id
legacy assignment history is never invented

reservation.legacy_rule: person_name alone never proves member identity

reservation_member.legacy_rule: existing RUT relationship remains supported during migration

movement.historical_rule: historical movements are never inferred as PROGRAMADO

movement_member.purpose: optional future person manifest associated with a movement
movement_member.legacy_rule: never manufacture members from aggregate people_count

bed_block.integrity: active block cannot overlap active occupancy of the same bed

daily_capacity.fallback: canonical operational universe when exact daily capacity is absent

snapshot.legacy_rule: legacy provenance remains unresolved or nullable when evidence is absent

import.purpose: source provenance for operational replacement imports
import.invariant: replacement of workers cannot erase durable identity or temporal history

invariants: normal application paths cannot update historical audit events
normal application paths cannot delete historical audit events
audit events identify the affected business entity whenever known
audit writes do not silently mutate operational business state

concurrency.conflict_semantics: real HTTP 409 on stale expected revision where applicable
concurrency.entity_versioning: may be added only when backward compatible and justified

provenance.rule: legacy provenance values are never fabricated
